interpretation: Execution happened only after a hash-bound approval record existed and the hash was re-verified inside the sandbox.
The script ran as a non-root user with no host drive and no outbound network; therefore it could not reach the lab target (expected connection failure), which is the isolation working as designed.
This is NOT evidence that the vulnerability does not exist; it is evidence that the execution gate and isolation gate work in that order.
It is also NOT a per-row human review of the 36-case batch.
